title: Japan, Worked Out.
note: Print palette derived 2026-09-17 from the site's «Washi Crest» identity (aizome indigo + antique gold + sakura on warm washi). NOT lifted verbatim: the site's --indigo #1e3a78 is a screen blue and goes flat as ink at small sizes, so the book's accent is deepened and very slightly warmed. Fonts differ from the site by design — the book runs Zen Old Mincho for display because it carries BOTH Latin and Japanese glyphs in one design, which matters in a book that prints 出口 and ¥ alongside English. Japanese fallback is Hiragino Mincho ProN (macOS system).

derivation.paper: site --washi #f4eee2 → #F5EFE1 · warmed a touch; washi stock reads warmer on paper than on a backlit screen
derivation.ink: site --ink #23262d → #242A33 · lifted and cooled slightly; a near-black that dark closes up in ink on a cream sheet
derivation.accent: site --indigo #1e3a78 → #1B3670 · deepened; aizome indigo is the identity and a screen-weight blue dies at small sizes and low coverage
derivation.gilt: site --gold #be9a43 → #B89547 · softened; screen gold is harsh on a cream stock
derivation.sakura: site --sakura #d98aa0 → #C87F94 · desaturated; used ONLY as the seasonal accent, never as a second brand colour
derivation.line: site --line #e3d9c4 → #E1D7C2 · near-identical, warm hairlines already work in print
derivation.muted: site --ink-soft #5a5e68 → #5C6068 · unchanged in character; caption and label grey

fonts.display_note: carries Latin AND Japanese in one design — chosen so 出口 beside English does not shift register
fonts.body_note: low-contrast Latin book face; prints cleanly at 13px on warm stock
fonts.local: all Latin faces are local woff2 under build/fonts/ with local-fonts.css — never base64 (bug log #34)
